title.value: Successive-Cancellation Decoding of Reed-Muller Codes with Fast Hadamard Transform
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper on decoding techniques for Reed-Muller codes using Fast Hadamard Transform.
title.quote: Successive-Cancellation Decoding of Reed-Muller Codes with Fast Hadamard Transform

extractions.description: The paper presents a novel permuted fast successive-cancellation list decoding algorithm with fast Hadamard transform (FHT-FSCL) to improve the error-correction performance of Reed-Muller codes. The proposed algorithm reduces computational complexity, decoding latency, and memory requirements while maintaining error-correction performance comparable to state-of-the-art algorithms.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is highly technical and focuses primarily on improving error-correction algorithms for communication systems, specifically Reed-Muller codes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Reed-Muller (RM) codes are a class of linear error-correction codes introduced by Muller [1] and Reed [2].

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on technical advancements in error-correction algorithms, with no direct relation to climate or ecological sustainable development topics.
primary_category.quote: The proposed decoder significantly improves the error-correction performance of the FHT-FSCL decoder [18].

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no identifiable sub-category related to sustainable development within the focus of this technical paper on error-correction codes.
primary_sub_category.quote:
Our contributions are summarized as follows.
1) We propose a novel permuted FHT-FSCL (p-FHT-FSCL) decoding algorithm of RM codes to significantly improve the error-correction performance of the FHT-FSCL decoder [18].
